newsitem.title: ITALY: One dead, two injured in Italian port shooting.
newsitem.headline: One dead, two injured in Italian port shooting.

text.p: One man was shot dead and two were injured in the north-western Italian port of Genoa on Tuesday when a workman fired at colleagues, police said.

They said the 40-year-old man turned up at a container repair yard and fired at six workmen as they were eating their lunch inside one of the large metal containers that had been turned into a canteen and changing room.
Two of the workers disarmed the man, who then fled the scene by car. Police had set up roadblocks across the city.
